summary: feat(shared): add tagCriticalEvent and browser compat API to sentry libs
description:
Because:
- FXA-14700 and FXA-14701 must move Sentry callers by import path only.
- The split Sentry libs lack tagCriticalEvent, tracesSampler and the default object.

This commit:
- Adds CRITICAL_ENDPOINTS and tagCriticalEvent to sentry-utils.
- Adds skipOpenTelemetrySetup and tracesSampler to SentryConfigOpts.
- Runs tagCriticalEvent before beforeSendServer in sentry-node.
- Adds browser tracing and the default export to sentry-browser.
- Re-exports the default from the sentry-browser entrypoint.

Closes FXA-10670
